display.purpose: List title only; 800 weight, uppercase, tight tracking.

body.purpose: Everything else at 13px; rank by case, weight, reversal and rule.

label.purpose: Command text such as the ADD plate.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: All state changes are instant cuts; disabled globally.

components.name: Wordmark Plate
components.description: Reversed ink plate carrying the app name atop the sidebar.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { margin: 0; padding: 18px 16px; background: var(--ink, #0c0c0c); color: var(--paper, #f4f5f5); font: 700 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Add Plate
components.description: Primary command: black plate that inverts with an inset ring on hover.
components.css: .ds-add { padding: 18px 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink, #0c0c0c); color: var(--paper, #f4f5f5); font: 700 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-add:hover { background: var(--paper, #f4f5f5); color: var(--ink, #0c0c0c); outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0c0c0c); outline-offset: -6px; } .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--stamp, #d42a12); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline-bordered secondary command; destructive hover fills with the stamp.
components.css: .ds-ghost { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #0c0c0c); border-radius: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: var(--stamp, #d42a12); border-color: var(--stamp, #d42a12); color: var(--on-stamp, #fff); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--stamp, #d42a12); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: List Index Item
components.description: Sidebar list row with count at right; hover and current are reversed plates.
components.css: .ds-list { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; padding: 11px 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #0c0c0c); border-radius: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-list:hover, .ds-list[aria-current='true'] { background: var(--ink, #0c0c0c); color: var(--paper, #f4f5f5); } .ds-list[aria-current='true'] { font-weight: 700; } .ds-list:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--stamp, #d42a12); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Task Line
components.description: Numbered ruled line with square checkbox and due date; row inverts on hover.
components.html: 01File customs formOct 30
components.css: .ds-task { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 36px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; min-height: 54px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #0c0c0c); font: 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--ink, #0c0c0c); background: var(--paper, #f4f5f5); } .ds-task:hover { background: var(--ink, #0c0c0c); color: var(--paper, #f4f5f5); } .ds-num { padding-left: 32px; color: var(--dim, #55595b); } .ds-task:hover .ds-num, .ds-task:hover .ds-due { color: inherit; } .ds-check { appearance: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; border: 3px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-check:checked { background: currentColor; } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--stamp, #d42a12); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-title { padding: 14px 16px 14px 8px; } .ds-due { padding: 0 16px; color: var(--dim, #55595b); text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Overdue Stamp
components.description: Double-ruled vermilion plate replacing the due date on overdue tasks.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; margin: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; outline: 2px solid var(--stamp, #d42a12); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--stamp, #d42a12); color: var(--on-stamp, #fff); font: 700 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Add Row Input
components.description: Borderless full-width field; the row rule is its edge, focus is a vermilion inset ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Add a task (press N)" aria-label="New task">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 18px 32px; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink, #0c0c0c); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; caret-color: var(--stamp, #d42a12); font: 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--dim, #55595b); opacity: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--stamp, #d42a12); outline-offset: -3px; }

narrative.overview:
Taskly reads as a printed waybill, not a card list. A list is a manifest; a task is a numbered, ruled line. Everything is one monospace size (13px) except the list title (up to 56px); hierarchy comes from case, weight, reversal and rule, never from size steps, tint or elevation. The soft rounded to-do look is the confirmed rejection.

The surface is two-tone ink on paper with one vermilion stamp color. Hover inverts a row instantly. There is no radius and no motion; state changes are cuts, not transitions. Density is ledger-tight: 54px task lines separated by 1px rules, heavier 3px rules for structure.
keyCharacteristics: One type size plus one oversized title; rank by case, weight, reversal, rule.
Ink-and-paper only, with a single vermilion stamp accent.
3px structural rules, 1px line rules, square corners everywhere.
Reversal (ink plate with paper text) marks identity, selection and hover.
Light and dark are the same form inverted, with a brighter stamp in dark.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks only urgency and interaction: overdue, destructive hover, focus, caret, selection. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is reversal (swap paper and ink), not a new color.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: Apart from the list title, nothing exceeds 13px. Rank with case, weight, reversal and rule.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Separate with a rule or a reversal, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Cut Rule
rules.body: State changes are instant. Nothing eases, fades or slides.

dos: Do rank with case, weight, reversal and rule at 13px; reserve the 56px size for the list title.
Do use 3px rules for structure and 1px rules between lines.
Do express hover and selection as full reversal (ink fill, paper text).
Do keep vermilion to overdue, destructive hover, focus, caret and selection, and always pair it with the matching on-stamp text color.
Do redefine only the five custom properties for the dark theme.
donts: Don't use border radius, shadows, gradients or blurs.
Don't add transitions or animation; state changes are cuts.
Don't introduce a second accent color or tinted greys for emphasis.
Don't add intermediate font sizes to create hierarchy.
Don't return to rounded cards or soft to-do styling.
